name: Prostate Cancer Whole Blood – K2-EDTA (8 mL)
description:
Additional Information

Fresh whole blood from donors with confirmed prostate cancer, spanning localized low-risk disease through castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC). The K2-EDTA format preserves nucleic acid integrity for PSA gene expression, AR splice variant detection, and CTC enrichment.

name: Large Valve Oven for GC (Simple-Customize)
description:
• Takes up no additional bench space
  • Six-position isothermal valve oven for actuated valves, micro-gasifiers, needle valves, and columns (including 1/8-in packed columns) with access to valve connections without removing actuators
  • Can accommodate 4-, 6-, 10-, or 14-port valves including Hastelloy valves
  • Dual thermal zones allow for thermal isolation between column oven and LVO
  • Independent control of LVO and GC oven zones
  • Maximum operating temperature of 330 °C (depending on columns and valves)
  • Ability to configure analyses that require multiple thermal zones, for example, run isothermal in the LVO while temperature ramping the GC oven
  • Easy maintenance and servicing
  • Enables highly configurable analyzers
short_description:
The Agilent Large Valve Oven (LVO) for 8890 and 7890B GC systems is a versatile, high-capacity external oven that can be configured to support complex, multi-valve gas chromatography applications. Unlike auxiliary valve ovens from other GC manufacturers, it is mounted on top of the gas chromatograph, optimizing precious laboratory bench space.

Precisely engineered for thermal isolation from the GC oven, the LVO provides a homogeneous isothermal environment that accommodates up to six positions for columns and valves, with convenient open access for maintenance, adjustment, or customization. Accessibility, capacity, and thermal uniformity make the Agilent LVO ideal for performing various ASTM and EN methods on a single gas chromatography platform.

name: Jet Stream Technology Ion Source-Single-Single
description:
• Agilent Jet Stream technology significantly enhances sensitivity relative to standard electrospray ionization
  • Superheated nitrogen sheath gas confines the nebulizer spray and improves desolvation of ions
  • Improved ion generation and sampling efficiencies for increased signals and noise reduction
  • Five-to-tenfold improvement in sensitivity over ESI at conventional flowrates (50 µL/min to 2.5 mL/min)
  • Consistent operating parameters across a wide range of flow rates reduces the need for re-optimization
short_description:
The thermal gradient focusing technology used in the Agilent Jet Stream high sensitivity ion source extends the sensitivity of electrospray ionization for a wide array of applications and flow rates.

This exclusive technology for high-sensitivity MS uses superheated nitrogen to improve droplet desolvation and ion generation, for a stronger signal and reduced noise. It offers the highest sensitivity for most analytes, and a response that is five-fold higher or more relative to standard electrospray ionization.

short_description:
The 1260 Infinity III Prime LC System is an analytical high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) system, offering the flexibility of both an HPLC and a UHPLC for columns with sub-2 μm particles. It can operate at high pressures and handle flow rates up to 5 mL/min. This HPLC/UHPLC system gives you the utmost confidence in your HPLC results and can be a front end for your LC/MS system.

 

  • Automates your daily HPLC tasks, ensuring reliable HPLC results
  • Delivers gradient formation/mixing performance equivalent to a binary-like system
  • Provides excellent retention time reproducibility, accuracy, and precision
  • Offers seamless method transfer with Intelligent System Emulation Technology
  • Mediates solvent effects with Feed Injection using a Hybrid Multisampler
